molecular_data.study: Moreyra et al. (2025), original S1 nuclear sampling, uniquely indexed source BioSamples
molecular_data.original_blind_gene_selection: all 12 external sources >=40% ACGT across original locus before looking at head U/D and phylogenetic trees

supported_molecular_ecological_position: The 6 frozen North American target-capture source molecules are consistently more similar to one another than to the 5 Western Palearctic source molecules within every complete original nuclear gene with audited pair overlap; the split is not a 1–2 outlier-locus artifact. It is SOURCE molecular geographic structuring, not evidence of any U/D trait adaptation.
unestablished_claims: The 75 loci are 75 independently verified orthologous gene trees supporting a particular species-tree split; they are p-distance contrasts on original nuclear alignments with potential paralog/homeolog and mapping uncertainty
The source 6 North American and 5 European samples constitute population-randomized representatives of their continents or a general worldwide species-tree contrast
The exchangeability-label exact 1/462 p-value is a phylogenetically adjusted, spatially adjusted or causal ecological p-value
Any phylogenetic distance caused U/D direction, flower colour, pollinator attraction or environmental adaptation
Reversible Mk U-D model indicates actual repeated independent D-to-U gains, event ages or historical precipitation BIO15 cause
Complete 294 unique BioSample originally selected Moreyra 350-nuclear-locus world phylogeny has been reconstructed
source_morphology_scope: Original Moreyra S1 = BioSample/sample voucher/reads; Siniscalchi's nine traits and independent botanical head descriptions are separate sources, not quantified phenotypes on sequenced molecular vouchers
